units.source_text: 从中学的时候起，K就经常问一些宗教、哲学之类玄而又玄的问题来为难我。

en.t: From the time we were in middle school, K would often trouble me with abstruse questions about religion, philosophy, and the like.

units.source_text: 我不知道这是他生父的影响，还是他出生的家庭，即寺院这种特殊建筑里的氛围的影响，

en.t: I do not know whether this came from the influence of his birth father, or from the atmosphere of the family into which he was born, that is, the special kind of building called a temple,

units.source_text: 总之，K给我的印象仿佛比一般和尚更具有和尚的特性。

en.t: in any case, K struck me as having even more of the qualities of a monk than ordinary monks did.

units.source_text: 本来K的养父家是打算送他到东京学医的，

en.t: Originally, K's adoptive family had meant to send him to Tokyo to study medicine,

units.source_text: 可固执的K打定主意，来东京不当医生。

en.t: but stubborn K had made up his mind that he would come to Tokyo and not become a doctor.

units.source_text: 我责问他：‘你这不等于欺骗养父母吗？’

en.t: I reproached him, saying, 'Isn't that the same as deceiving your adoptive parents?'

units.source_text: 但只要为了将来的路，这些也算不了什么。’

en.t: But if it is for the path ahead, something like that is nothing.'

units.source_text: 他所说的‘将来的路’是什么，他自己也未必很清楚，我当然就更不用说了。

en.t: What he meant by 'the path ahead' was probably not very clear even to himself, and needless to say, it was even less clear to me.

units.source_text: 但是，对年轻幼稚的我们而言，这个概念模糊的词语却发出了神圣的回响。

en.t: But to us, young and naive as we were, that vague phrase had a sacred resonance.

units.source_text: 尽管不理解它的内容，但我们的内心却被一种崇高的情感所支配，

en.t: Although we did not understand what it contained, our hearts were ruled by a lofty feeling,

units.source_text: 根本不可能看到朝那个方向努力的满腔热血之中暗藏着卑鄙。

en.t: and it was impossible for us to see anything base hidden within the passionate resolve to strive in that direction.

units.source_text: 我赞同K的说法，我也不知道我的赞同对于K有多大支持。

en.t: I agreed with what K said, though I do not know how much support my agreement gave him.

units.source_text: 因为我看得出，无论我怎样反对，一根筋的K也绝不会改变初衷。

en.t: For I could see that, however much I opposed him, single-minded K would never change his original intention.

units.source_text: 尽管我是个孩子，也知道由于自己支持过他，一旦有什么事，自己多少也要承担责任。

en.t: Even though I was still a child, I knew that because I had supported him, if anything happened, I too would have to bear some responsibility.

units.source_text: 纵然那时连这一点都不懂得，当有必要以成人的眼光回首往事的时候，

en.t: Even if I had not understood even that much at the time, when it becomes necessary to look back on the past with an adult's eyes,

units.source_text: 我也必须说，当时自己是以‘我的那份责任，理应由我来承担’的语气说那番话的。

en.t: I must still say that I spoke then in a tone that implied, 'The share of responsibility that is mine ought to be borne by me.'
